title: IDD Claim Marker Payload
description: Structured claim-marker payload parsed from claimed-by comments.

agentId.description: Agent identifier recorded as the owner of the claim marker.

claimId.description: Opaque identifier for this claim lineage and its heartbeats.

supersedes.description: Claim identifier replaced when this claim lineage was minted, or none for a fresh claim; unchanged on later heartbeat markers for the same claim.

branch.description: Implementation or coordination branch associated with the claim.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp used to order the marker and evaluate claim freshness.
